description.zh: 业务日期。一般是周期实例定时时间的前一天的0点0分0秒，格式为毫秒级时间戳，如1743350400000。
description.en: The data timestamp. The value of this parameter is 00:00:00 of the day before the scheduling time of the instance. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds. Example: 1743350400000.

description.zh: 过滤器。JSON格式，多个过滤条件之间是"且"的关系。目前支持的字段有：`startedTimeStart, startedTimeEnd, finishedTimeStart, finishedTimeEnd, createTimeStart, createTimeEnd`
description.en: The filter. It is in JSON format, and multiple filter conditions are combined with a logical AND. Currently supported fields include: `startedTimeStart`, `startedTimeEnd`, `finishedTimeStart`, `finishedTimeEnd`, `createTimeStart`, `createTimeEnd`.

description.zh: 任务实例ID。任务实例存在重跑的情况，假如设置该参数，则返回包含重跑的历史信息，通过RunNumber区分每个历史信息。
description.en: The ID of the instance. The instance may be rerun. If the instance is rerun and you configure this parameter, the system returns the historical information of the instance, including the rerun information. You can use the RunNumber parameter to distinguish each entry in the historical information.

description.zh: 任务实例ID列表，可根据任务实例Id批量查询多个任务实例信息。
description.en: The IDs of the instances. You can query multiple instances at a time by instance ID.

description.zh: 任务的责任人的账号ID。
description.en: The account ID of the task owner.

description.zh: 页码，从1开始，默认为1。
description.en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 每页的条目数，默认为10，最大为500。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

description.zh:
项目环境。
- Prod：生产
- Dev：开发
description.en:
The environment of the workspace. Valid values:

- Prod: production environment

- Dev: development environment

description.zh: 项目ID。
description.en: The DataWorks workspace ID.

description.zh: 资源组信息，这里请填入调度资源组标识符。
description.en: The information about the resource group. Set this parameter to the identifier of a resource group for scheduling.

description.zh:
排序字段。支持定时时间、开始时间等字段，格式为"排序字段+排序方式(Desc/Asc)"（Asc可以缺省）。排序字段的枚举值如下：

- `TriggerTime (Desc/Asc)`

- `StartedTime (Desc/Asc)`

- `FinishedTime (Desc/Asc)`

- `CreateTime (Desc/Asc)`

- `Id (Desc/Asc)`

  默认值：`Id Desc`
description.en:
The field used for sorting. Fields such as TriggerTime and StartedTime are supported. The value of this parameter is in the Sort field + Sort by (Desc/Asc) format. By default, results are sorted in ascending order. Valid values:

- `TriggerTime (Desc/Asc)`

- `StartedTime (Desc/Asc)`

- `FinishedTime (Desc/Asc)`

- `CreateTime (Desc/Asc)`

- `Id (Desc/Asc)`

  Default value: `Id Desc`.

description.zh:
任务实例的状态：
- `NotRun`：未运行
- `Running`：运行中
- `Failure`：运行失败
- `Success`：运行成功
- `WaitTime`：等待时间
- `WaitResource`：等待资源
description.en:
The status of the task instance.

- `NotRun`: Not started

- `Running`

- `Failure`

- `Success`

- `WaitTime`: Awaiting scheduled time

- `WaitResource`: Awaiting resources

description.zh: 对应任务的ID。
description.en: The ID of the task for which the instance is generated.

description.zh: 对应任务的ID列表，可根据任务Id批量查询任务实例。
description.en: The IDs of the tasks. You can query multiple instances at a time by task ID.

description.zh: 对应任务的名称，支持模糊查询。
description.en: The name of the task. Fuzzy match is supported.

description.zh: 任务类型。各节点的TaskType取值，请参见[DataWorks节点合集](~~600169~~)。
description.en: The type of the task for which the instance is generated.

description.zh:
触发时的运行模式，TriggerType=Scheduler时生效。
- Pause：暂停
- Skip：空跑
- Normal：正常运行
description.en:
The running mode of the instance after it is triggered. This parameter takes effect only if the TriggerType parameter is set to Scheduler. Valid values:

- Pause

- Skip

- Normal

description.zh:
触发方式类型。
- Scheduler：周期调度触发
- Manual：手动触发
description.en:
The trigger type. Valid values:

- Scheduler: scheduling cycle-based trigger

- Manual: manual trigger

description.zh: 统一工作流实例Id，某次触发下某业务日期内的所有任务实例的该字段值相等。
description.en: The unified workflow instance ID. For all task instances under a specific data timestamp within a single trigger, this field has the same value.

description.zh: 所属工作流的ID。
description.en: The ID of the workflow to which the instance belongs.

description.zh: 所属工作流实例的ID。
description.en: The workflow instance ID.

description.zh:
所属工作流实例的类型。
- SmokeTest：测试
- Manual：手动任务
- SupplementData：补数据
- ManualWorkflow：手动工作流
- Normal：周期调度
- TriggerWorkflow：触发式工作流
description.en:
The type of the workflow instance. Valid values:

- SmokeTest: Testing

- Manual: Manually triggered node

- SupplementData: Data backfill

- ManualWorkflow: Manually triggered workflow

- Normal: Scheduled execution

- TriggerWorkflow: Triggered Workflow

descriptions.zh: 需要购买DataWorks基础版及以上版本才能使用。
descriptions.en: You must purchase DataWorks Basic Edition or a higher edition to use this feature.
